claim: Patchline ships a partner SDK enabling third parties to ship new hazard classes with conformance tests. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the conformance tests claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make partner-hazard-sdk-gate`.
